home.title: Welcome to Dokko Filler
home.description: This platform lets you generate contracts quickly and easily. Create and review contracts in one place, with maximum efficiency and an intuitive experience.

choose.title: Choose a contract
choose.text: Pick a template from the list of available contracts.

load.title: Load the documents
load.text: Insert an ID card or vehicle registration card into the reader and the data fills in by itself.

download.title: Review and download
download.text: Check how the document looks and download the finished .docx file.

about.title: About Dokko
about.purpose: This platform generates contracts automatically. The goal of the app is to make filling in various types of contracts faster and simpler, which saves time and makes work more efficient.
about.goal: Our goal is to improve your productivity and offer an experience that is intuitive and pleasant.

tutorial.offerText: Would you like a short tour? Using made-up data, you will go through the whole process in about a minute: choosing a contract, loading the documents and previewing the filled-in contract.
tutorial.offerNote: You can start the tour later at any time from the “Demo” menu.

choose.label: Choose a contract
choose.hint: Every contract is a Word template with fields that fill in by themselves. Click “Run demo” on the contract below.

load.label: Load the documents
load.hint: In real use you insert an ID card or vehicle registration card into the reader and click the card. Here, a click on each card loads made-up data. Check it; you can remove a card that was loaded by mistake.

preview.label: Review and download
preview.hint: All the data is here. Click “Preview document” at the top right: you will see the filled-in contract, with the fields the app entered highlighted.

tutorial.done: That is the whole process. From the preview you can print the contract or download it as .docx. Now try it with your own contracts and real documents.
tutorial.demoNote: Demo mode: the data is made up; no reader or login is needed.

demo.title: Contracts
demo.subtitle: A demo list of contracts with prepared data. Choose a contract to run the whole process without logging in or loading documents.
